configVersion.markdownDescription: The config format this config is written in. The engine reads its own major version up to its own minor version.

inventory.markdownDescription: What the organization is expected to have; compared on every run, never changed.

owners.markdownDescription: Logins of the owners, at least one.

apps.markdownDescription: One entry per installed GitHub App, as its installation shows it; [] for none.

webhookHosts.markdownDescription: Hosts of the organization webhooks, not the URL, which can be a secret; an internationalized host in its xn-- form. [] for none.

outsideCollaborators.markdownDescription: Logins of the outside collaborators; [] for none.

default_repository_permission.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"none"`. Members see only the repositories they are given; a base permission opens every private repository to every member, a compromised account included.

members_can_create_repositories.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Owners create repositories, so each one is deliberate and gets the organization settings.

members_can_create_public_repositories.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A public repository created by mistake publishes its code and history to everyone.

members_can_create_private_repositories.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Owners create repositories, so each one is deliberate and gets the organization settings.

members_can_create_pages.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A Pages site publishes repository content to the internet, from private repositories too.

members_can_fork_private_repositories.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A fork of a private repository keeps its code in a personal account, outside the organization.

deploy_keys_enabled_for_repositories.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A deploy key is a repository credential that belongs to no person and never expires; turning this off also disables existing keys.

email.markdownDescription: Public contact address on the organization page, where security reports go. Project data: the contact address of the organization.

is_verified.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. A verified domain shows people that this is the real organization.

two_factor_requirement_enabled.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. A stolen password alone must not be enough to act as a member.

members_can_delete_repositories.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Deleting or transferring a repository loses its code and history; only owners should.

members_can_change_repo_visibility.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Making a private repository public publishes it; only owners should decide.

members_can_invite_outside_collaborators.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Outside collaborators get repository access without being members, so nobody reviews them with the members. Only GitHub Enterprise Cloud can restrict it: on other plans, keep true with an exception.

members_can_create_teams.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Teams grant repository access; only owners should create them.

members_can_delete_issues.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Deleting an issue removes its record for good.

readers_can_create_discussions.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Read access is for reading; starting discussions needs write access.

members_can_create_public_pages.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A public Pages site publishes repository content to everyone.

members_can_create_private_pages.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A Pages site publishes repository content beyond the repository, with or without access control.

display_commenter_full_name_setting_enab.markdownDescription: Shows the profile name of a comment author in the pull requests of private repositories. Owner decides: who sees profile names is a matter of privacy within the organization, not of security.

web_commit_signoff_required.markdownDescription: Contributors sign off the commits they make in the web interface, such as for a Developer Certificate of Origin; the page shows false as "No policy". Owner decides: a sign-off policy, such as a Developer Certificate of Origin, is a legal process, not a security setting.

default_repository_branch.markdownDescription: The default branch of new repositories. Project data: the branch name the projects use.

has_organization_projects.markdownDescription: Members can create projects of the organization. Owner decides: whether the organization plans its work in GitHub Projects.

has_repository_projects.markdownDescription: Repositories of the organization can have projects; no settings page shows it. Owner decides: whether the organization plans its work in GitHub Projects.

members_can_view_dependency_insights.markdownDescription: Members can see the dependency insights of the organization; no settings page of GitHub Team shows it. Owner decides: GitHub Team shows no page and has no API to change it, so a recommendation could only be waived.

secret_scanning_push_protection_custom_l.markdownDescription: A link shown when push protection blocks a commit, or null. Project data: a link to the organization's own guidance, where it has one.

secret_scanning_validity_checks_enabled.markdownDescription: GitHub checks whether a found secret is still valid; it needs Secret Protection, which budgets stop. Owner decides: it needs Secret Protection, a paid product the budgets stop; buying it is a decision of its own.

two_factor_secure_methods_required.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. SMS codes can be intercepted; passkeys, security keys and apps cannot.

projects_base_permission.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"none"`. A project shows the issues and pull requests it tracks; members see only the projects they are given.

app_access_requests.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"members_only"`. An outside collaborator cannot ask for an app that reaches the code of the organization.

members_can_install_github_apps.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. An app gets access to code and often to workflows, so only owners install them.

members_can_rename_protected_branches.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Only owners rename a branch the organization ruleset protects.

commit_comments.markdownDescription: Owner decides: a collaboration feature, not a security setting.

members_can_change_project_visibility.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Making a project public publishes what it tracks; only owners should decide.

enabled_repositories.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"all"`. Every repository may run workflows; the policies below limit what they run. none turns Actions off.

allowed_actions.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"selected"`. Only GitHub actions and the listed ones run, so a new third-party action needs a deliberate change here.

sha_pinning_required.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. A tag or branch can be moved by the action owner after review; a full commit SHA cannot.

github_owned_allowed.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. Actions published by GitHub are trusted like the platform itself.

verified_allowed.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A verified creator is not a reviewed action; list third-party actions one by one in patterns_allowed.

patterns_allowed.markdownDescription: Actions allowed besides the GitHub-owned ones, such as azure/login@*. Add an action here and re-run before a workflow starts using it. Project data: the actions the workflows of the organization use.

default_workflow_permissions.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"read"`. A workflow token only reads unless the workflow asks for more, which limits what a compromised step can do.

can_approve_pull_request_reviews.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A workflow that approves pull requests bypasses human review.

enabled_repositories.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"none"`. A self-hosted runner runs repository code on your own machine and keeps state between jobs; GitHub-hosted runners are discarded after each job.

approval_policy.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"all_external_contributors"`. A workflow from a fork runs someone else's code; a maintainer approves it first for every outside contributor.

run_workflows_from_fork_pull_requests.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Workflows from forks of private repositories run code nobody has reviewed.

send_write_tokens_to_workflows.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A workflow from a fork must not get a token that writes to the repository.

send_secrets_and_variables.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A workflow from a fork must not see the repository secrets.

require_approval_for_fork_pr_workflows.markdownDescription: Only matters while run_workflows_from_fork_pull_requests is true; until then GitHub keeps it false and the plan leaves it alone. Recommended: `true`. Should workflows of fork pull requests ever run, a person approves each run before code from a fork gets the repository's token or secrets.

days.markdownDescription: How long artifacts and logs are kept: 1 to the organization maximum (400 for private repositories). Project data: how long the organization needs workflow artifacts and logs.

retention_days.markdownDescription: Project data: GitHub's default suits most projects; a longer retention keeps more cache, billed as storage.

size_limit_gb.markdownDescription: Project data: GitHub's default suits most projects; a larger cache is billed as storage.

include_claim_keys.markdownDescription: Project data: follows the OIDC subjects the cloud identities of the organization trust.

use_immutable_subject.markdownDescription: Project data: follows the OIDC subjects the cloud identities of the organization trust.

enabled_repositories.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"none"`. The cloud agent changes code and opens pull requests from tasks: it works only where it is needed.

public_code_suggestions.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"block"`. Less risk of code under someone else's license.

ide_chat.markdownDescription: Copilot Chat in the editors of the members. Owner decides: a Copilot feature the seats are bought for; whether members use it is a decision of the organization, not a security setting.

platform_chat.markdownDescription: Copilot on GitHub.com and GitHub Mobile; the page names it Copilot in the cloud, which replaced Copilot Chat in GitHub. Owner decides: a Copilot feature the seats are bought for; whether members use it is a decision of the organization, not a security setting.

cli.markdownDescription: Copilot CLI in the terminal; it also governs the GitHub Copilot app before its version 1.1. Owner decides: a Copilot feature the seats are bought for; whether members use it is a decision of the organization, not a security setting.

code_review.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"enabled"`. The ruleset asks Copilot to review every pull request; null is a policy the organization never configured.

ai_credit_paid_usage.markdownDescription: Owner decides: paid usage beyond the included credits is a cost decision, capped by the ai_credits budget.

bill_reviews_to_organization.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. Reviews count against ai_credits of budgets, not the quota of the member; billed to the member, a review fails with insufficient remaining quota.

reviews_without_license.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. The organization does not pay for reviews of Dependabot and outside contributors.

code_review_preview_features.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Preview features of code review fall under the pre-release terms.

default_policy_new_features.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled"`. A new Copilot feature starts only after someone decides on it.

feedback_collection.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. The feedback may include sensitive information.

cloud_preview_features.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Preview features fall under the pre-release terms.

metrics_api.markdownDescription: Owner decides: metrics of Copilot use stay within GitHub; whether to collect them is a decision of the organization.

metrics_industry_comparison.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled"`. Enabled, the organization contributes its aggregated metrics to comparisons with other organizations.

usage_metrics.markdownDescription: Owner decides: metrics of Copilot use stay within GitHub; whether to collect them is a decision of the organization.

mcp_servers.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled"`. No third-party server is connected to Copilot.

agent_mode_ide.markdownDescription: Owner decides: a Copilot feature the seats are bought for; whether members use it is a decision of the organization, not a security setting.

editor_preview_features.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled"`. Preview features of the editors, MCP servers among them, fall under the pre-release terms.

github_desktop.markdownDescription: Owner decides: a Copilot feature the seats are bought for; whether members use it is a decision of the organization, not a security setting.

copilot_app.markdownDescription: Owner decides: a Copilot feature the seats are bought for; whether members use it is a decision of the organization, not a security setting.

cli_billed_to_organization.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. The Copilot CLI of automations that no member runs would spend the AI credits of the organization.

cloud_sessions.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled"`. The CLI and VS Code sessions of members are stored on GitHub; with control, whoever holds a member's account steers the agent on the member's machine from github.com.

web_search.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled"`. A web search sends parts of the question, and so of the code, to Bing.

model_native_search.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled"`. The search of a model sends parts of the question to the search of its provider.

external_semantic_indexing.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled"`. Members would upload code from outside GitHub for indexing.

spaces.markdownDescription: Owner decides: a Copilot feature the seats are bought for; whether members use it is a decision of the organization, not a security setting.

spaces_individual_access.markdownDescription: Owner decides: a Copilot feature the seats are bought for; whether members use it is a decision of the organization, not a security setting.

spaces_individual_sharing.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled"`. A Space of a member, with what it holds of the code, could be shared with others.

commit_messages.markdownDescription: Owner decides: a Copilot feature the seats are bought for; whether members use it is a decision of the organization, not a security setting.

user_memories.markdownDescription: Owner decides: a Copilot feature the seats are bought for; whether members use it is a decision of the organization, not a security setting.

repository_memories.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"none"`. Copilot keeps no facts about private repositories while nobody needs them.

memory_retention_days.markdownDescription: Owner decides: how long Copilot keeps memories, a trade-off between usefulness and the data kept.

dreaming.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled"`. A preview that changes memories without approval and proposes changes to files of the repositories.

bring_your_own_key.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled"`. Code does not go to a third-party model outside the control of the organization.

default_review_effort.markdownDescription: The review effort stored for the organization; null inherits the default, which the page shows as "Default (Balanced)". A deeper effort costs more AI credits per review. Owner decides: a deeper review costs more AI credits per review.

maximum_review_effort.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"balanced"`. Nobody requests Max reviews (about $10 each, in preview).

approve_pull_requests.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled_everywhere"`. An approval by Copilot would satisfy the required approval of the ruleset, and a pull request would merge without a person.

block_external_license_reviews.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. Only licenses of the organization request reviews; the automatic reviews of the ruleset still run.

code_review_runner_type.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"standard"`. Reviews run on the standard GitHub runner; a custom runner costs more and is another place the code runs.

code_review_allow_repository_customizati.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A repository cannot move its reviews to a runner of its own.

cloud_agent_runner_type.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"standard"`. The cloud agent runs on the standard GitHub runner; a custom runner costs more and is another place the code runs.

cloud_agent_allow_repository_customizati.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A repository cannot move the cloud agent to a runner of its own.

default_availability.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled"`. A new model, possibly with other data retention terms (the page notes one for Claude Fable 5), becomes available only after someone decides on it.

cloud_firewall.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. An agent that reads the code reaches only the allowlisted locations.

cloud_recommended_allowlist.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. The agent installs packages and tools only from the locations GitHub recommends.

cloud_repository_custom_rules.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A repository admin cannot open more network access than the organization allows.

code_review_firewall.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. A reviewer that reads the code reaches only the allowlisted locations.

code_review_recommended_allowlist.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. The reviewer installs packages and tools only from the locations GitHub recommends.

code_review_repository_custom_rules.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A repository admin cannot open more network access than the organization allows.

allow_automations.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"none"`. The cloud agent is not used, and a repository cannot turn automations on by itself.

allow_shared_automations.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Shared automations run as the organization and are billed to it.

require_write_access.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. Someone without write access cannot start an automation.

update_triggering_resource_only.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. An automation changes only what started it.

require_workflow_approval.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. The workflows of its pull requests wait for a person.

claude.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. No other agent works in the repositories of the organization.

codex.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. No other agent works in the repositories of the organization.

name.markdownDescription: Name of the code security configuration the engine manages. Project data: the name of the configuration.

description.markdownDescription: Description of the configuration, or null. Project data: the description of the configuration.

default_for_new_repos.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"all"`. Every new repository gets the configuration without anyone remembering to attach it.

enforcement.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"enforced"`. Repository admins cannot turn the features off.

dependency_graph.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"enabled"`. Dependabot needs the dependency graph to know what a repository uses.

dependabot_alerts.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"enabled"`. Known vulnerabilities in dependencies are reported.

dependabot_security_updates.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"enabled"`. Dependabot opens pull requests that fix vulnerable dependencies.

private_vulnerability_reporting.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"enabled"`. A researcher can report a vulnerability of a public repository privately instead of in a public issue.

name.markdownDescription: Name of the organization ruleset the engine manages; it protects the default branch of every repository. Project data: the name of the ruleset.

enforcement.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"active"`. A disabled ruleset protects no branch.

organizationAdmin.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"pull_request"`. An organization owner can merge a pull request without the approvals, which GitHub records, but never push to a default branch directly; none leaves no way past the rules.

deletion.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. Nobody can delete the default branch of a repository.

non_fast_forward.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. Nobody can force-push to a default branch and rewrite its reviewed history.

workflows.markdownDescription: Central workflows every pull request of every repository must pass, each pinned to a commit of a repository of the organization, so write access to that repository alone cannot change a check. Project data: the central workflows of the organization.

repository.markdownDescription: Name of the repository of the organization that holds the workflow, such as .github.

path.markdownDescription: Path of the workflow file in that repository.

sha.markdownDescription: Full commit SHA of the workflow file to run.

required_approving_review_count.markdownDescription: Recommended: `1`. Every change to a default branch is approved by someone other than its author.

dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. A commit pushed after an approval needs a new approval, so no unreviewed code joins an approved pull request.

require_last_push_approval.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. Someone other than the person who pushed last approves, so nobody approves their own last change.

require_code_owner_review.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. A change to files with code owners needs the approval of one of them; it has no effect in a repository without a CODEOWNERS file.

required_review_thread_resolution.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. Every review comment is resolved before the merge, so none is lost.

require_extra_approval_for_unattributed_.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. A change GitHub cannot attribute to a person, such as one made by Copilot, needs one more approval.

allowed_merge_methods.markdownDescription: Recommended: `["merge"]`. Reviewed and tested commits reach the default branch with the same SHAs; the ruleset does not turn off the other methods in the repository settings.

requiredReviewers.markdownDescription: Teams that must approve changes to some files in every repository. A team counts only where it has write access. One entry with minimum_approvals of at least 1 must cover .github/workflows/**, unless an exception names this field. Project data: the teams of the organization; the entry that covers the workflows is a rule of its own.

team.markdownDescription: Slug of the team of the organization.

minimum_approvals.markdownDescription: How many members of the team must approve, 0 to 10.

file_patterns.markdownDescription: File patterns, as in CODEOWNERS, whose changes the team must approve.

enabled.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. Copilot reviews every pull request, and its comments are resolved before the merge; false leaves the rule out of the ruleset. It needs Copilot Business.

review_on_push.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. Copilot reviews every new push too, so the changes made after its review are reviewed as well; each review costs AI credits.

review_draft_pull_requests.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Copilot reviews a pull request once it is ready for review, so a draft that still changes costs no AI credits.

budgets.markdownDescription: One entry per budget of the organization; a paid product without a budget has no limit. [] for none.

budget_type.markdownDescription: BundlePricing for ai_credits, ProductPricing for a product, SkuPricing for a single SKU.

budget_product_sku.markdownDescription: The product or SKU id, such as actions or ghas_secret_protection_licenses.

budget_amount.markdownDescription: Whole dollars a month; the number of licenses for a license-based SKU.

prevent_further_usage.markdownDescription: Whether usage stops at the limit.

copilotSeats.markdownDescription: Who holds a Copilot seat; every seat is paid. A login or team without a seat is planned, a seat outside this list is only a warning.

selected_usernames.markdownDescription: Logins that hold a seat of their own; [] for none.

selected_teams.markdownDescription: Slugs of the teams whose members hold a seat; [] for none.

fine_grained.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"restrict"`. A forgotten token keeps write access to main, and so to the deployment, until it expires; allow it only while someone needs one.

classic.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"restrict"`. A classic token with repo reaches every repository and cannot be limited; gh auth login uses an OAuth token, not a classic one.

policy.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"restricted"`. Without it, every OAuth app a member authorized reads the private repositories.

access.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled"`. One less place where the code and its secrets run. The API writes it but cannot read it back, so only a person can check it.

ownership.markdownDescription: Owner decides: it matters only while Codespaces are enabled (codespaces.access), and then decides who pays.

public_creation.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. No public package or container is published by mistake.

inherit_access.markdownDescription: Recommended: `true`. A new package is visible to whoever sees its repository, nobody else.

enabled.markdownDescription: Owner decides: a collaboration feature, not a security setting.

limit.markdownDescription: A temporary limit on who can interact with the public repositories; none while no limit is set (GitHub answers {}). A limit expires on its own. Owner decides: a temporary measure during an incident on a public repository, which expires on its own.

pull_request_cap_enabled.markdownDescription: A cap on the open pull requests of a user without write access in each public repository. Owner decides: a spam measure for public repositories, which matters once they receive outside pull requests.

enforced_repositories.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"all"`. Once published, a release cannot have its assets changed or its tag moved, so what a workflow downloaded by tag stays what was reviewed.

default_level.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"public"`. What Dependabot reads in a repository becomes visible to every member through its updates, so it reads only public repositories unless one is added on purpose.

agentic_autofix.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Copilot opens fix pull requests for alerts and consumes AI credits for each.

ai_scan_repositories.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A preview that scans default branches with AI at a cost; turn it on deliberately.

ai_scan_pull_requests.markdownDescription: Recommended: `"disabled"`. Each scan of a pull request costs AI credits; turn it on deliberately.

scan_ai_applications.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. A preview that scans pull requests with AI at a cost; turn it on deliberately.

code_quality.markdownDescription: Recommended: `false`. Code quality scanning charges Actions minutes, which the budgets stop at 0.

exceptions.markdownDescription: Deliberate deviations from a recommended value or a rule, each with a reason and an expiry date at most one year ahead; [] for none.

field.markdownDescription: Path of the field the exception covers.

category.markdownDescription: waiver: the risk is accepted. mitigated: another control covers it.

reason.markdownDescription: Why the recommended value or the rule is not followed.

expiresOn.markdownDescription: Last day the exception applies, at most one year ahead; then the warning or error returns.

reference.markdownDescription: An issue or decision behind the exception, or null.
